gene_master_table_hpo.gene_id: internal HPO gene identifier (NCBIGene:XXXXXXXX) — PK; sole home of gene identity, join key only
gene_master_table_hpo.gene_symbol: official HGNC gene symbol — the ONLY table that stores gene_symbol; e.g. BRCA1, TP53, CFTR, FGFR3, LMNA

disease_master_table_hpo.disease_id: disease identifier in OMIM:XXXXXX / ORPHA:XXXXXX / DECIPHER: format — PK; join key only
disease_master_table_hpo.disease_name: name of the disease or syndrome — the ONLY table that stores disease_name; e.g. Marfan syndrome, Down syndrome, Neurofibromatosis type 1, Phenylketonuria. 215 of 14,868 rows (1.4%) have NULL disease_name (all OMIM IDs for which no name is available); exclude these rows in disease-name-filtered queries.

phenotype_master_table_hpo.phenotype_id: HPO term identifier in HP:XXXXXXX format — PK; sole home of phenotype identity (all 19,389 terms), join key only; e.g. HP:0001250
phenotype_master_table_hpo.phenotype_name: canonical HPO term name — the ONLY table that stores phenotype_name; e.g. Seizure, Intellectual disability, Ataxia, Microcephaly, Short stature
phenotype_master_table_hpo.definition: 2,484 of 19,389 rows (12.8%) have NULL definition — filter with col.is_not_null() before displaying. Non-null definitions describe the clinical meaning of the HPO phenotype term. Users may ask for 'definition' or 'meaning' of a phenotype term.

gene_phenotype_association_hpo.gene_phenotype_frequency: observed frequency of the phenotype in patients carrying this gene variant; expressed as fraction (e.g. 7/42) or HP frequency term

phenotype_hierarchy_hpo.phenotype_id: FK to phenotype_master_table_hpo.phenotype_id — the child term
phenotype_hierarchy_hpo.parent_id: FK to phenotype_master_table_hpo.phenotype_id — the parent term one level up in the HPO hierarchy

phenotype_synonym_hpo.synonym: alternate name or synonym for the HPO phenotype term; used for synonym-based lookups

gene_disease_association_hpo.ncbi_gene_id: NCBI Entrez Gene ID as a bare integer string; e.g. 121278; the prefix-stripped form of gene_id; used when asking for NCBI gene ID
gene_disease_association_hpo.association_type: type of gene-disease association; observed values: UNKNOWN (Orphanet-sourced, 8290 rows), MENDELIAN (7043 rows), POLYGENIC (581 rows)
gene_disease_association_hpo.source: Source URL for the gene-disease association. Only two values appear on disk: 'http://www.orphadata.org/data/xml/en_product6.xml' (8,290 rows, UNKNOWN association type) and 'ftp://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gene/DATA/mim2gene_medgen' (7,624 rows, MENDELIAN+POLYGENIC). Filter by URL substring to distinguish Orphanet vs OMIM-derived associations.

disease_phenotype_annotation_hpo.qualifier: qualifier for the phenotype annotation; reserved for 'NOT' to mark an explicitly-absent phenotype, but in this snapshot the column is null in 100% of served rows (no 'NOT' values present)
disease_phenotype_annotation_hpo.reference: literature or database reference supporting the annotation; e.g. PMID:12345678, OMIM:123456
disease_phenotype_annotation_hpo.evidence: evidence code for the annotation; e.g. IEA (inferred from electronic annotation), PCS (published clinical study)
disease_phenotype_annotation_hpo.onset: age of onset HP term; e.g. HP:0003593 (Infantile onset), HP:0003577 (Congenital onset)
disease_phenotype_annotation_hpo.disease_phenotype_frequency: frequency of the phenotype in affected patients; expressed as fraction (e.g. 7/42) or HP frequency term (HP:0040282)
disease_phenotype_annotation_hpo.sex: sex-specific restriction of the phenotype annotation; e.g. MALE, FEMALE; null when not sex-specific
disease_phenotype_annotation_hpo.modifier: clinical modifier HP term for the annotation; e.g. HP:0012832 (Bilateral), HP:0012834 (Right)
disease_phenotype_annotation_hpo.aspect: HPO annotation aspect: P=Phenotypic abnormality (264207 rows), C=Clinical course (8444 rows), I=Inheritance/Mode of inheritance (9104 rows), H=Past medical history (124 rows), M=Clinical modifier (78 rows)
disease_phenotype_annotation_hpo.biocuration: biocuration metadata including curator identifier and date; e.g. HPO:probinson[2021-06-21]
